items.citation_text: Announcing Mackenzie Health’s new President and CEO; Mackenzie Health Insider: May 2026 [mackenziehealth.ca], [mackenziehealth.ca]
items.verbatim_snippet: Carmine Stumpo began as President and CEO on April 13, 2026, succeeding interim President and CEO Mary-Agnes Wilson. The hospital’s appointment announcement states that Carmine Stumpo joined from Orillia Soldiers’ Memorial Hospital, where he had served as President and CEO since 2018. A subsequent hospital update described his first month in the role and confirmed that he had joined the organization.

items.citation_text: Announcing Mackenzie Health’s new President and CEO [mackenziehealth.ca]
items.verbatim_snippet: The Board appointed Carmine Stumpo as the organization’s next President and CEO, effective April 13, 2026. The announcement also recognized Mary-Agnes Wilson, who had served as interim President and CEO since July 2025, and said that the permanent appointment followed a national search.

items.citation_text: Announcing Mackenzie Health’s new Chief of Staff [mackenziehealth.ca]
items.verbatim_snippet: Dr. David Rauchwerger was appointed Chief of Staff effective December 15, 2025. He succeeded Dr. Steven Jackson, whom the hospital credited for a decade of leadership as Chief of Staff. The hospital stated that the selection followed a collaborative search involving Board members, physicians and organizational leaders.

items.citation_text: Welcoming the new Chair of the Mackenzie Health Board of Directors [mackenziehealth.ca]
items.verbatim_snippet: John Fursey was announced as the new Chair after being appointed at the June 19 annual meeting. The hospital noted that he had joined the Board in 2023 and had served on the Finance and Audit, Human Resources and Governance committees.

items.citation_text: A leadership update from Mackenzie Health [mackenziehealth.ca]
items.verbatim_snippet: Mary-Agnes Wilson, then Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer and Chief Nursing Executive, was appointed interim President and CEO. The hospital said that she would lead during the transition while recruitment proceeded for a permanent successor.

items.citation_text: A leadership update from Mackenzie Health; Unity Health Toronto welcomes Altaf Stationwala [mackenziehealth.ca], [unityhealth.to]
items.verbatim_snippet: The hospital announced that Altaf Stationwala would leave after more than 14 years as President and CEO. His final day at Mackenzie Health was specified as June 27, 2025, ahead of beginning as President and CEO of Unity Health Toronto on July 1.
